fusions.name: Rote Envenoming
fusions.desc: Spits a venom bolt that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Finished Pattern
fusions.desc: Pulls a laid web tight, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rewound Spool
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Wrap by Wrap
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
